author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
I have an interesting observation. Those who knows how to write assembly has much better time coping with coding with AI.

Most AI nay sayers are those never experience the joy (and pain) of low level programming. They grown up in the nice and tidy high level language and framework world that are now shattered by LLM.
